about_the_game:
✨ Welcome to the Jingle — VR Bowling, Holiday Chaos, and Elf Attitude!

You’re Santa. You bowl. The elves judge you.

Jingle Strike — VR Bowling combines true-feel bowling physics with absurd Christmas comedy. Every throw has real weight and spin, and every miss gets you roasted by a cast of animated elves who cheer, jeer, dance, argue, and occasionally… fart.

Bowl across four fully-themed festive lanes, each packed with lights, snow, mischief, and animated elf reactions. Smash a strike and they celebrate. Miss a pin and they really celebrate.

And when you’re ready for something different, jump into 85 Second Slam-Down — a high-speed, non-Christmas arcade mode built for pure bowling mayhem.

Perfect for parties, families, or anyone who loves VR bowling with personality.

🎄 What’s Inside

🎅 Four Festive VR Bowling Lanes

From Santa’s Workshop to Candy Cane Lane, each lane is full of life, charm, and elf chaos — with more lanes planned!

🎳 Realistic Bowling Physics

Every roll has authentic weight, spin, and impact. If you hit a strike, you earned it — and the elves know it.

😂 Fully Reactive Elves

They cheer.
They roast you.
They dance.
They complain about loud music.
They want biscuits.
They fart.
They never repeat the same reaction twice.

🔥 85 Second Slam-Down (Arcade Mode)

No Christmas décor — just neon lights, fast resets, heart-pounding music, and pure skill-based VR bowling.

🏆 Leaderboards & Challenges

Compete globally for Top Bowler or Slam-Down Champion.

📸 Pin Cam

Cinematic replays and hilarious elf animations for every strike, spare, and fail.

🎁 Throwables & Reactions

Snowballs, gifts, pins — hurl them at elves and watch them react in ridiculous ways.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 1–5 Player Couch VR

Pass the headset and bowl together. Great for holidays, parties, and after-dinner chaos.

🎄 Family-Friendly Fun

Festive, funny, easy to play — no bowling shoes required.

The elves won’t take bowling seriously… but you might.

Welcome to Jingle Strike — VR Bowling.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Requires a VR headset (Meta Quest 2/3 via Link, PS VR2 with PC adapter, or equivalent), USB 3.0, DisplayPort
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8 GB+)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Requires a VR headset (Meta Quest 2/3 via Link, PS VR2 with PC adapter, or equivalent), USB 3.0, DisplayPort

short_description: A hilarious VR bowling game where the elves roast every shot you take. Crush strikes with real-physics bowling across festive lanes, or get heckled when you miss. Fast, funny, family-friendly holiday chaos—perfect for parties and VR newcomers.
